decisions.reason: Specifying the HubSpot report as a simple sales funnel does not change how lead lists are created or managed.
The reporting-format decision does not alter the HubSpot task-assignment system.
A simple sales-funnel report does not change which communication channels are visible on HubSpot lead records.
The source selects a reporting format but does not modify the existing lead-classification mechanisms.
The sales-funnel reporting format has no entailed effect on inclusion of lead notes.
The source concerns report presentation and does not change lead-nurturing workflows.
The report-format choice does not alter the HubSpot status values synchronized from MeetAlfred or LinkedIn.
The simple sales-funnel report does not change the LinkedIn-to-HubSpot transfer path, unit, automation, or timing.
The HubSpot reporting format does not change synchronization of HubSpot lists or contacts to MeetAlfred.
The reporting decision is a separate reporting requirement and does not modify the general HubSpot CRM configuration state.
Selecting a simple sales-funnel report does not affect Apollo enrichment data, mode, provider, or target.
The reporting-format decision does not change the CRM requirement for LinkedIn profile URLs or exclusion of Sales Navigator-specific URLs.
